core_obligations: Prove the punctured-spectrum assertion via the formal-sections machinery
Deduce the general bound by a prime-avoidance cutting-down argument

proof_roadmap.step: Handle the empty punctured spectrum with cd-bound-dim-local; pass to the reduction
Apply Lemma application-theorem and track idempotents to get a disconnected V, bounding c by cd(A, I)
For dim Z = e, choose f_1,...,f_e inductively by prime avoidance keeping w_1, w_2 in the vanishing locus and conclude

difficulty_reason: The retained proof carries both stages in full: the final assertion is proved by splitting the empty/punctured cases, applying Local Cohomology cd-bound lemmas, reducing to the reduced complete ring with dualizing complex, then applying Lemma application-theorem to identify colimit H0 with the formal limit and deriving a contradiction from idempotents on a disconnected U cap Y; the general statement is deduced by an inductive prime-avoidance choice of f_1,...,f_e cutting Z down dimension by dimension while keeping the separating points inside. Retained author proof at lines 4604-4662.
